item.title: Know your stakes
item.description: Different contexts require different levels of rigour. Not everything needs the same security mindset — but you always need to know which context you’re in.

item.title: Review what AI gives you
item.description: Don't accept AI output without understanding it It’s easy to let the agent do its thing and move on. You get a working feature, the tests pass, the diff looks reasonable.

item.title: Review your AI Skills
item.description: Skills control what your agent does on your behalf Skills are markdown files that get injected into your agent’s prompt. They tell the agent how to behave, what commands to run, what patterns to follow.

item.title: The danger of shipping AI code without review
item.description: The danger of shipping AI code without review OpenClaw showed the world you can build an entire project by letting an AI agent write and ship code without reviewing it ...

item.title: Close the loop - let agents verify their work
item.description: One of the biggest wins when coding with AI agents is closing the loop — giving them the ability to verify their own work. If the agent can’t confirm that a change works, you’re back to being the bottleneck.

item.title: Discipline
item.description: I wish I had more discipline. I keep breaking down my own promises Discipline isn’t punishment. It’s not about control Then what is it? It’s self-respect at the highest level.
